# RipeText

Canonical site: https://www.ripetext.com/

RipeText is a Performance OS for support teams that analyzes customer conversations to uncover QA gaps, recurring issues, sentiment trends, automation opportunities, and training needs.

## Audience

RipeText is built for support, CX, operations, quality, and compliance leaders who need to understand customer conversations at scale. It is most relevant for teams with meaningful ticket, chat, email, or issue volume across one or more support platforms.

## Core Workflows

- Automated Support QA: scores support conversations and helps teams understand why a conversation did or did not meet quality expectations.
- Issue Radar: clusters support tickets and conversations by the underlying problem, measures growth, and helps teams prioritize high-impact issues.
- Topic Discovery: groups conversations into living topics and surfaces emerging spikes before they become escalations.
- Sentiment analysis: tracks customer tone across conversation volume so teams can spot shifts early.
- Automation opportunities: identifies repeated support work that may be suitable for automation or process improvement.
- AI Persona Training: creates practice scenarios from real QA gaps so agents can rehearse difficult conversations.
- Ivy AI Assistant: RipeText's AI CX Data Scientist and proactive teammate. Ivy answers natural-language questions about agent performance, issue trends, customer risk, and training gaps, and proactively surfaces blind spots 24/7.
- FHA Compliance: applies RipeText conversation intelligence to leasing and property-management communications to detect risky fair housing language early.

## Integrations

RipeText integrates with support and customer communication systems including Zendesk, Intercom, Front, HubSpot, Crisp, and GitHub Issues.

Documentation:

## FHA Compliance Context

RipeText FHA Compliance is a specialized workflow inside the RipeText platform. It scans leasing and property-management communications for Fair Housing Act risk, flags problematic language, cites the relevant compliance context, and helps teams detect risky customer communication early.

Canonical URL: https://www.ripetext.com/fha-compliance
